topology: One machine, three original node executables online; fourth original validator absent, then catch-up, four-node cold restart and successor.

timings.scope: Overlapping wall-clock spans include fixture and HTTP observation costs; do not sum nested fields or report them as normal-load TPS or exact internal commit latency.

propagation_gate.scope: Bounded local queue acceptance beyond shared capacity, not peer delivery or finality.

repair_observed_at_online_completion.interpretation: Repair was exercised. Remote strict-admission counters and actual complete finalized receipts support useful remote progress; the local repair reservation count alone does not establish delivery or uniqueness.

progress.sample_clock_origin: after propagation gate, before polling online published heights
progress.interpretation: The long sampled gaps align with the deliberately absent proposer's four turns and observed unchanged Propose/Precommit waiting. Healthy-proposer heights all decided in round zero. Two follower body misses were observed briefly, without an extra deciding round. No sustained online-proposer empty-pool or missing-body stall was observed in this run; sampling cannot prove absence of every transient wait.

final_state.economic_check_scope: The offline balances helper derives payer and recipient expectations from actual receipt charged_fee; this is not the load fixture's independent full treasury and fee-model oracle.

limits: One finite functional fault run does not establish stable fault latency or repair capacity.
Progress observations are sequential HTTP samples, not an atomic view or internal timer trace.
Later deciding rounds plus timeout-step samples support the absent-leader waiting explanation here, not every earlier run's cause.
Ordinary stale-context and retired-round rejection errors remain in snapshots; the result is not an error-free-log claim.
Restart occurs after confirmation; no write-in-flight, power-loss or unknown-ACK injection is claimed.
No production timer, propagation deadline, quorum threshold, or ninety-second stall/two-hundred-forty-second total fixture limit was changed.
